versions.content: If the optional configuration parameter FRIF_E_NIT_CH_B ex- ists, then the channel status information shall be reported to DEM as Dem_Set EventStatus (FRIF_E_NIT_CH_B, DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED) when any of the error bits of a single controller (Channel B NIT status data vSS!SyntaxError, v SS!Bviolation) is set or as Dem_SetEventStatus (FRIF_E_NIT_CH_B, DEM_EVENT_ STATUS_PREPASSED) when none of these error bits is set.
